description: One of the full-screen scenes of Poe's stream overlay (atpota.to/overlay?scene=...): the countdown before a stream, the be-right-back screen, the end screen, or the frame for sharing a screen with a camera. One record per scene, at the scene's name as its record key: "starting", "brb", "ending" or "screenshare". The overlay reads it from your repo and follows changes live.

subtitle.description: A line under them: what the stream is about.

background.description: The backdrop behind it all (the screen share's frame colour).

showWidgets.description: Whether the weather widgets from the overlay's settings show on this scene too.

links.description: Where to find the streamer, on the end screen ("bsky.app/profile/dame.is").

countdown.description: The starting screen's countdown: to a time, or a timer that starts when the scene is shown.

at.description: For a clock: when the stream starts.
